so `THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md` is new and the README's License

  into it drops automated MIT detection below the threshold licensee/ScanCode use, which

operations.description: L3 - license-files is PEP 639 and needs setuptools>=77; the floor said 64

edits.replace:
# >=77, not >=64: PEP 639 `license-files` (below) is ignored by older setuptools,
# so a clean build env resolving 64-76 would silently drop THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md
# from the distribution that needs it.
requires = ["setuptools>=77"]
